essence: Done fruitless ends birth; freed seed unsprouting; own-formed all fearless griefless; jewel-heaped I-Lord misfortune-free; no-abode no-journey knot-cut manifestation; knotted cut freed though bodied; burnt seed unbirthing deed; limited mind contracts knowing to body; stainless vow stated.

sections.SUMMARY: Done yet fruitless — how birth? Birth-bond gone, the Śiva-sun shines by its own rays. As husk-freed seed unsprouting, the freed self unbirthing. All own-formed: fearless, griefless, since perishing is not. Jewel-heaped from the heart-treasury — 'I indeed' in the Lord-state: what misfortune? Liberation has no abode, no journey: knot-cut, own-power-manifest. Knotted cut, doubted gone, delusion cast, merit wasted — bodied yet freed. As burnt seed unsprouting, burnt deed unbirthing. Limited mind, contemplating fit bodies, contracts knowing to the falling body. If again stainless knowing, all-transcending, spread, never-setting light-formed, true-resolved...

rasa.justification: I-voice exulting: driving, shining, composing, freed.
